title: Range Response
text: Range response, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, {Range processing window} sets Range FFT weighting window; {Measurement mode}, {Range processing method}, {Propagation speed (m/s)} sets the signal propagation speed physconst, {Inherit sample rate}, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sampling rate, {FM sweep slope (Hz/s)} sets the fM sweep slope 1e9, {Dechirp input signal} enables dechirping of input signal, {Source of FFT length in range processing} sets the source of FFT length for range processing, {FFT length in range processing} sets the range processing FFT length, {Range sidelobe attenuation level} sets the sidelobe attenuation for range processing, {Set reference range at center} sets the reference range at center of range grid, {Reference range (m)} sets the reference range of range grid and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.
